name: Daddy's Not Home
source:
This new VN will have multiple chapters and will be released periodically. As long as you hit the 3 months mark, you will automatically receive each chapter whenever it is ready.
Compared to other VNs, this VN will be a kinetic novel (KN). This means that there is a linear storyline & player choice does not matter. The end result will be the same.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/ellofatdog]Patreon[/url]]
